summary: Well‑executed, preregistered paired study comparing a verifier+bounded repair pipeline to accepting a single LLM candidate under a shared_initial estimand. Execution and analysis artifacts appear complete and internally consistent; results show near‑ceiling baseline performance (299/300) with a single deterministic rescue by the permitted repair. The manuscript is methodically transparent and reproducible, but contains bibliographic/formatting and provenance‑presentation defects that must be corrected before finalisation.
critical_issues: Manuscript uses OpenAlex URL tokens and archive‑style links inline in Related Work and body text instead of normal scholarly citations and a conventional reference list; this violates the requirement for literature‑grounded scholarly prose and must be fixed using the verified bibliographic records archived with the run (terminal_bibliographic_records).

Narrative contains excessive in‑body provenance and file/path/hash listings that substitute for concise scholarly exposition (metadata‑heavy prose). Several places present machine paths and artifact hashes inline where a concise pointer to the archived run bundle (with manifest) plus a short methodological summary would be appropriate. This must be edited to restore normal conference paper prose while preserving the required Disclosure Statement and archival pointers.
required_revisions: Replace all inline OpenAlex URLs and archive placeholders in Related Work and throughout the manuscript with conventional scholarly citations (author-year or numbered IEEE style) and include properly formatted BibTeX entries using the archived terminal_bibliographic_records. Do not leave OpenAlex links as narrative evidence placeholders.

Remove or substantially condense inline file paths, raw artifact hashes, and execution manifest listings from the main body. Instead (a) add a concise sentence citing the archived run bundle and manifest (provide the manifest path/hash once in the Disclosure Statement), and (b) relocate the low‑level provenance inventory to the archived artifact bundle referenced in the Disclosure Statement. Preserve the Disclosure Statement content but present it in compact scholarly prose rather than as an inline inventory of paths/hashes.
optional_revisions: Add a brief methodological justification for the paired bootstrap percentile CI choice given minimal discordance, and/or report an exact effect‑size bound alternative to supplement the bootstrap (artifacts needed for exact alternatives are archived).

Explicitly call out in Methods and/or Limitations that the preregistered optional pilot was not run and that this reduces power to detect small effects (the manuscript already discloses this; consider moving the sentence earlier in Methods for clarity).

In Discussion, expand a short paragraph on how results would differ under alternative estimands (resampling/interactive repair) and on tradeoffs between repair budget and model‑call cost (refer to the archived repair_stage_count/model_calls_used values).
Replace any remaining informal or provenance‑style figure/table captions with concise interpretive captions suitable for IEEE two‑column format.
